Pascal’s Triangle Generator

Build Pascal’s triangle up to 20 rows and click any cell to see its binomial coefficient and parents.

Click any cell to inspect it.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the number of rows (1–20).
  2. Press Build triangle.
  3. Click any cell to see its value, row, column and how it was formed.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What do the numbers mean?

Each entry is the binomial coefficient C(n, k) — the number of ways to choose k items from n.

Why does each row sum to a power of 2?

Row n sums to 2^n because it counts all subsets of an n-element set.

How is each cell computed?

Every interior cell is the sum of the two cells directly above it: C(n,k) = C(n−1,k−1) + C(n−1,k).
